description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the two-step setup workflow: run `scripts/setup.sh` then `scripts/configure.sh`. 2. Agent runs `scripts/setup.sh +573001234567` — this creates relay-workspace/agent/agent.json with role=relay, copies auth-profiles.json to the relay workspace, patches openclaw/dist/openclaw.core.js SAFE_SESSION_ID_RE regex to allow `:` and `+` characters (creating a .bak backup), and appends the 'Relay de WhatsApp' section to openclaw/agents/main-agent/SOUL.md. The proprietary trap here is the international phone format requirement and the SOUL.md language being Spanish. 3. Agent runs `scripts/configure.sh +573001234567 +447700900111 +12025550173` — this generates wa-relay-routing.yaml in the current directory. 4. Agent reads references/SETUP.md to discover the required destination path: config/routing/wa-relay-routing.yaml, and copies/moves the generated file there. The final routing config must contain the relay_agent_id, NO_REPLY token, main-agent session target, and both VIP numbers in the direct_allowlist.
